conflicts_and_limits: AI activity/acceptance/provisioning cannot substitute for quality, value or causal measurement.
Four engineering success zones are distinct from four framework layers; linked metric content reviewed separately.
Monorepo is conditional alternative and cannot override approved function-owned polyrepo model.
Fine-grained file review is not fine-grained repository access control.
Named metrics APIs and product scope are dated unverified source assertions.
Rights, links, adoption and independent omission audit remain separate.
